column3: NKJV has “the fruit of the Spirit,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the fruit of the light.”
NKJV has “in the fear of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in the fear of Christ.”
NKJV has the verb “submit,” following the Textus Receptus; in the critical text the verb is carried over from verse 21.
NKJV has “just as the Lord does,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “just as Christ does.”
NKJV includes “of His flesh and of His bones,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
